title: The Solar Empress
subtitle: A garland of white diamond fanning open across the collar.

stone.origin: Flanking the center, a dramatic fan of marquise and pear-cut white diamonds radiates outward in a foliate garland motif — movement frozen in platinum. Two graduated rows of round brilliant diamonds complete the collar, sweeping the neck in a seamless arc of white light.

description: A dramatic fan of marquise and pear-cut white diamonds radiates outward from the centre in a foliate garland — movement frozen in platinum, each stone angled as if caught mid-open. Below it, two graduated rows of round brilliants complete the collar, sweeping the neck in a seamless arc of white light. The design belongs to the grand garland tradition, built so the eye travels the full width of the piece and finds no seam — only a continuous unfurling of light across the collarbone. Set entirely in platinum.
